subject: SIG evidence submission and follow-ups - CloudPrime diligence
messages:
From: Ellie Hart <ellie.hart@cloudprime.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudprime.com
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire - evidence request and target timeline

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. CloudPrime is moving your SIG through our internal vendor review and we have a few outstanding evidence items before we finish the technical review:

- Screenshots showing KMS key rotation schedule and the actual rotation entry for the past 12 months
- A current copy of the authentication & access control policy (PDF)
- A short runbook (or playbook) describing token revocation for compromised service accounts
- The filled SIG spreadsheet (we have a few questions on answers in section A.3)

Can you provide these by end-of-day (PST) Wednesday 10/7? If you need an exception, let me know and we can push our deadline a day but we are trying to keep the procurement window tight.

Thanks,
Ellie
Ellie Hart
Senior Security Reviewer, CloudPrime
ellie.hart@cloudprime.com

Plan:
- Today: Vanessa compiles screenshots and a short runbook draft; Monica exports the SIG spreadsheet and the auth policy PDF.
- Tomorrow morning: I will assemble a single Drive folder and share links with the CloudPrime reviewers.

If you have a preferred place for the files (e.g., a Hub folder or a DocuSign packet), tell me and we’ll put them there.

Best,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Hart <ellie.hart@cloudprime.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire - evidence request and target timeline

Hi Ellie — I uploaded the requested evidence to a shared Drive folder and included quick notes next to each file. Folder link below (read-only):

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD9_example_Redwood_SIG

Files included (high level):
- redwood_auth_policies.pdf — canonical AuthN/AuthZ policy (v2026-09-30)
- kms_config_screenshot.png — KMS console view with last rotation row visible
- kms_rotation_schedule.png — exported rotation schedule (CSV snapshot)
- sig_answer_snapshot.png — screenshot of the completed SIG cells we discussed
- runbook_token_revocation.txt — immediate revocation steps + escalation contacts
- SOC2-2025-summary.pdf (link in related_links) — control alignment reference

Quick summary for your reviewers:
- Access control: roles and approval flows are defined in the attached PDF; we use RBAC + short-lived tokens for service-to-service auth.
- KMS/EKM: keys rotate monthly; rotation is automated and logged. Screenshot shows last rotation on 2026-07-12.
- Evidence provenance: all artifacts are exported from the systems of record and time-stamped.

Please confirm if this set satisfies the SIG checks or if you need additional artifacts (e.g., CloudTrail filter output for the exact rotation event).

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Ellie Hart <ellie.hart@cloudprime.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudprime.com, Simon Nguyen <simon.nguyen@cloudprime.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence submission and follow-ups - CloudPrime diligence

Thanks Karthik — receiving the folder now. A few follow-ups after a quick pass:

1) The KMS screenshot is helpful, but our security team asked for a tamper-evident export that includes an audit log entry around the rotation event (we prefer a CloudTrail export or equivalent). Can you provide the single-line log or a short export covering 2026-07-12 to show the rotation activity?

2) The runbook looks good; could you confirm the service account name used for automated rotations? We want to check its IAM bindings.

3) On the SIG spreadsheet, section A.3: two answers are marked "see policy" — we need the exact policy paragraph copied into the cell (or a Drive permal link to the clause) to close out.

If you can supply the CloudTrail rotation event and the specific clause references by EOD today, we should be good to sign off. If not, we may need a 30-minute clarification call.

—Ellie

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ellie Hart <ellie.hart@cloudprime.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence submission and follow-ups - CloudPrime diligence

Ellie / team — copying in Legal so we can quickly close any open language.

We can provide the CloudTrail export for the rotation event as a signed, time-stamped export. Vanessa — can you pull the log line and redact any unrelated entries? Please include the service account principal name (it is redwood-kms-rotator@redwood-service).

Karthik — if CloudPrime would prefer a short call to walk the security team through the artifacts, I’m available tomorrow 10/8 between 10–12 PT; otherwise we’ll upload the log export and add the specific policy paragraph into the SIG sheet cell and re-share the folder.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Deputy General Counsel | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
